states.preparing: Owned fresh directory; original/request writes underway
states.prepared: Original and request saved, no attempt recorded
states.requesting: One request is about to be or has been issued; interrupted state requires reconciliation
states.succeeded: Exact output saved and final metadata committed
states.failed: Known error or local preparation failure; inspect actual HTTP/phase
states.uncertain: Provider may have processed; no automatic retry

fields.input: filename, original_filename, bytes, sha256, media_type, rows_if_known

desk_receiving.json_input: Use exact returned envelope.data as existing desk intake; preserve the whole envelope and operation ID
desk_receiving.review: Existing report identity, header mapping, corrections and accepted revision remain authoritative
desk_receiving.failed_operation: Keep source/status/failure with report operation history; never promote an error body into data
desk_receiving.credentials: Environment-only key; never retain headers or a secret in the workspace
